location: 頭頂部，以百會穴（GV20）為中心，前、後、左、右各1寸，共4個穴位。
locationEn: A group of four points at the vertex, located 1 cun anterior, posterior, and to each side of Baihui (GV20).
cunMeasurement: 先定百會（GV20），再向前、後、左、右各量1寸；四點呈十字形環繞百會。
anatomyZh: 四點均位於頭頂頭皮區並環繞百會。Board Outline、現有課件、eLotus 與 American Dragon 均未提供逐層神經血管解剖，本卡不自行補造深層結構。
anatomyEn: All four points lie in the vertex scalp region surrounding Baihui. The Board Outline, current course material, eLotus, and American Dragon do not provide layer-by-layer neurovascular anatomy, so deeper structures are not inferred here.
techniqueNotes:
課件與 eLotus：皮下刺0.5~1.0寸；課件另強調四針均朝中心。American Dragon：皮下刺0.5~1.0寸，另列斜刺0.5~1.0寸或橫刺0.5~1.5寸；可將四穴成組針刺，或由百會透刺。eLotus 與 AD 均記艾灸適用。
Curriculum and eLotus: subcutaneous insertion 0.5-1.0 cun; the curriculum additionally directs all needles toward the center. American Dragon: subcutaneous 0.5-1.0 cun, with additional slanted 0.5-1.0 cun or transverse 0.5-1.5 cun methods; the four points may be needled as a group or through-needled from Baihui. eLotus and AD state that moxibustion is applicable.
acumethodZh: 課件／eLotus：皮下刺0.5~1.0寸，課件要求針尖朝中心。AD：皮下刺0.5~1.0寸；另列斜刺0.5~1.0寸、橫刺0.5~1.5寸，以及四穴成組或由百會透刺。不同方法不視為單一共識。
acumethodEn: Curriculum/eLotus: subcutaneous insertion 0.5-1.0 cun, with the curriculum directing the needles toward the center. AD: subcutaneous 0.5-1.0 cun; it additionally lists slanted 0.5-1.0 cun, transverse 0.5-1.5 cun, and group needling or through-needling from Baihui. These methods are retained as source variants, not a single consensus.
moxaZh: eLotus 與 American Dragon 均記艾灸適用，但未提供時間或壯數；不補造劑量。
moxaEn: eLotus and American Dragon state that moxibustion is applicable but give no duration or cone count; no dose is inferred.

location: 眉間區，兩眉內側端連線的中點，即眉間（glabella）中央。
locationEn: At the glabella, on the midline at the midpoint between the medial ends of the eyebrows.
cunMeasurement: 不以寸量為主；以兩眉內側端的連線中點與眉間正中線定位。
anatomyZh: 位於眉間正中線的皮膚與皮下組織區。Board Outline、課件、eLotus 與 American Dragon 均未提供逐層神經血管解剖；AD 所列向攢竹（BL2）或睛明（BL1）方向的透刺版本只作技法差異保留，不據此推定安全層次。
anatomyEn: The point lies in the skin and subcutaneous tissues of the glabellar midline. The Board Outline, curriculum, eLotus, and American Dragon do not provide layer-by-layer neurovascular anatomy. AD's variants directed toward Zanzhu (BL2) or Jingming (BL1) are retained only as technique variants and are not used to infer a safe anatomical plane.
techniqueNotes:
課件：提皮，向下斜刺或皮下刺0.3~0.5寸。eLotus：皮下刺0.3~0.5寸，艾灸適用。American Dragon：一組版本為提皮後向下或側方橫刺0.3~0.5寸；另列向下或向攢竹（BL2）／睛明（BL1）方向0.5~1寸，可能出現局部脹痠並延至鼻尖；記艾灸適用。既有三稜針點刺出血法保留，但本輪三個內容來源未列，故不得視為四來源共識。
Curriculum: pinch the skin and insert obliquely downward or subcutaneously 0.3-0.5 cun. eLotus: subcutaneous insertion 0.3-0.5 cun; moxibustion is applicable. American Dragon: one version uses a pinched-skin transverse insertion inferiorly or laterally 0.3-0.5 cun; another directs the needle inferiorly or toward Zanzhu (BL2)/Jingming (BL1), 0.5-1 cun, with possible local distention and soreness extending to the tip of the nose; moxibustion is applicable. The legacy three-edged-needle bleeding method is retained, but none of the three content sources reviewed lists it, so it is not treated as four-source consensus.

location: 正視時，瞳孔直上，眉毛正中點的凹陷處。AD 補充傳統位置在眶上切跡外側。
locationEn: With the eyes looking straight ahead, in the depression at the midpoint of the eyebrow directly above the pupil. AD adds that the traditional location lies lateral to the supraorbital notch.
cunMeasurement: 不以寸量為主；以正視瞳孔垂直線與眉毛正中點交會處定位。
anatomyZh: 位於眉弓／眶上緣表淺區。American Dragon 指出傳統取穴在眶上切跡外側，眶上神經由該切跡穿出；其餘三層來源未提供逐層解剖。此解剖提示用於辨識局部敏感結構，不自行推導更深安全深度。
anatomyEn: The point lies superficially over the brow and superior orbital rim. American Dragon notes that the traditional location is lateral to the supraorbital notch, where the supraorbital nerve emerges; the other three source layers provide no layer-by-layer anatomy. This identifies a local sensitive structure but is not used to infer a deeper safe depth.
techniqueNotes:
eLotus／AD 共同基線：皮下刺0.3~0.5寸。課件：沿眉毛平行、輕柔進針，皮下刺0.5~1寸；可由攢竹（BL2）透向魚腰，並提示本穴敏感疼痛。AD 另列向內或向外橫刺0.5~1寸，可透向 BL2 或絲竹空（TE23），針感可延至眼球；亦記可由陽白（GB14）或 BL2 透刺刺激魚腰。既有三稜針點刺出血與禁灸記載在本輪三個內容來源均未找到，予以保留但不視為共識。
eLotus/AD shared baseline: subcutaneous insertion 0.3-0.5 cun. Curriculum: gentle subcutaneous insertion parallel to the eyebrow, 0.5-1 cun; Zanzhu (BL2) may be directed toward Yuyao, and the point is described as sensitive and painful. AD additionally lists medial or lateral transverse insertion 0.5-1 cun, including joining BL2 or Sizhukong (TE23), with sensation possibly extending to the eyeball; stimulation by through-needling from Yangbai (GB14) or BL2 is also noted. The legacy three-edged-needle bleeding and moxa-prohibition statements were not found in the three content sources and are retained without consensus status.
acumethodZh: eLotus／AD：皮下刺0.3~0.5寸。課件：沿眉平行、輕柔皮下刺0.5~1寸，或 BL2 透向魚腰。AD：向內／外橫刺0.5~1寸，可透向 BL2／TE23；另記可由 GB14 或 BL2 透刺刺激。本輪來源的深度和方向不同，分列而不合併；既有三稜針放血法待另源核實。
acumethodEn: eLotus/AD: subcutaneous insertion 0.3-0.5 cun. Curriculum: gentle 0.5-1-cun subcutaneous insertion parallel to the eyebrow, or BL2 toward Yuyao. AD: medial/lateral transverse insertion 0.5-1 cun, including joining BL2/TE23; it also notes through-needling from GB14 or BL2. These source-specific depths and directions remain separate. The legacy three-edged-needle bleeding method awaits another source.
moxaZh: 課件、eLotus 與 American Dragon 魚腰條目均未說明艾灸。既有『禁灸』保留為待核實警語；不補造時間、壯數或替代灸法。

exam_pearl_en: Locate it in the depression at the eyebrow midpoint directly above the pupil. Its core use is for eye disorders, supraorbital pain, eyelid twitching, and ptosis. The baseline is 0.3-0.5-cun subcutaneous insertion; the curriculum/AD 0.5-1-cun eyebrow-parallel through-needling methods are source-specific advanced variants.

cautions: 課件提示魚腰非常敏感、可能疼痛，要求沿眉平行並輕柔進針；AD 指出眶上神經由附近眶上切跡穿出，且橫刺針感可延至眼球。三個內容來源均未列正式穴位禁忌，因此不可把來源沉默解讀為無風險。0.3~0.5寸基線與0.5~1寸橫刺／透刺版本不得合併，較長透刺須由具備眼眶周圍解剖與相應技法訓練的持照針灸師執行。既有『不宜直刺過深』『禁灸』及三稜針放血均保留，但本輪未找到直接來源支持。
cautionsEn: The curriculum describes Yuyao as very sensitive and potentially painful, directing gentle insertion parallel to the eyebrow. AD identifies the nearby supraorbital nerve exit and notes that transverse needling sensation may extend to the eyeball.
The three content sources list no formal point-specific contraindication; source silence must not be interpreted as absence of risk.

The 0.3-0.5-cun baseline must not be merged with the 0.5-1-cun transverse/through-needling variants. Longer through-needling requires a licensed acupuncturist trained in peri-orbital anatomy and the specific technique.
The legacy cautions against deep perpendicular needling and moxibustion, plus the legacy three-edged-needle bleeding method, are retained but were not directly supported by the sources reviewed.

location: 顳部，眉梢與外眼角連線中點向後約1寸（約一橫指）的凹陷處，常可觸及壓痛。
locationEn: In the temporal region, in the often-tender depression about 1 cun (approximately one finger breadth) posterior to the midpoint between the lateral end of the eyebrow and the outer canthus.
cunMeasurement: 先連接眉梢與外眼角，取其中點，再向後量約1寸／一橫指至顳部凹陷。
anatomyZh: 位於顳部表淺區。課件特別提示避開可見血管並輕柔進針；Board Outline、eLotus 與 AD 未提供逐層神經血管解剖。AD 列多種長距離透刺法，但不能由技法文字反推深層安全結構。
anatomyEn: The point lies in the superficial temporal region. The curriculum specifically directs the practitioner to avoid the visible vein and insert gently; the Board Outline, eLotus, and AD provide no layer-by-layer neurovascular anatomy. AD lists several long through-needling methods, but their text is not used to infer deeper safe structures.
techniqueNotes:
eLotus／AD 共同基線：直刺0.3~0.5寸，或點刺出血；AD 指急性結膜炎或頭痛可刺出數滴血。課件另列直刺0.5~1寸、斜刺／皮下刺1~2寸，要求避開血管、輕柔進針。AD 還列直刺0.5~1寸或0.5~0.8寸、向後透率谷（GB8）0.5~1.5寸或1~2寸、向前斜刺0.3~0.5寸，以及向下透頰車（ST6）3寸。這些不是單一共識，長距離透刺只作來源別進階技法記錄。
eLotus/AD shared baseline: perpendicular insertion 0.3-0.5 cun or prick to bleed; AD specifies a few drops of Blood for acute conjunctivitis or headache. The curriculum additionally lists perpendicular insertion 0.5-1 cun and oblique/subcutaneous insertion 1-2 cun, with gentle insertion and avoidance of the vein. AD also lists perpendicular 0.5-1 or 0.5-0.8 cun, posterior through-needling toward Shuaigu (GB8) 0.5-1.5 or 1-2 cun, anterior oblique insertion 0.3-0.5 cun, and inferior through-needling toward Jiache (ST6) 3 cun. These are not a single consensus; long through-needling is retained only as source-specific advanced technique.
acumethodZh: 共同基線：直刺0.3~0.5寸，或點刺出血。課件：直刺0.5~1寸，或斜／皮下刺1~2寸，避開血管並輕柔進針。AD：另列0.5~1或0.5~0.8寸直刺、向後透 GB8 0.5~1.5或1~2寸、向前斜刺0.3~0.5寸、向下透 ST6 3寸。所有版本分列，不合併為通用深度。
acumethodEn: Shared baseline: perpendicular insertion 0.3-0.5 cun or prick to bleed. Curriculum: perpendicular 0.5-1 cun or oblique/subcutaneous 1-2 cun, avoiding the vein and inserting gently. AD additionally lists perpendicular 0.5-1 or 0.5-0.8 cun, posterior toward GB8 0.5-1.5 or 1-2 cun, anterior oblique 0.3-0.5 cun, and inferior toward ST6 3 cun. All variants remain separate rather than becoming a universal depth.

Headache/migraine, red swollen painful eyes, and deviation of the mouth and eye are core indications. cautions: 課件明確要求避開顳部血管並輕柔進針。eLotus 與 AD 均列點刺出血；AD 指急性結膜炎或頭痛時刺出數滴血，但三個內容來源未提供止血流程，因此既有『注意止血』保留為程序警語，不補造步驟。AD 的0.5~1.5／1~2寸向 GB8 透刺及3寸向 ST6 透刺，與共同基線0.3~0.5寸差異很大，僅限熟悉顳部解剖與該技法的持照針灸師依正式訓練選用。AD 的武術致命點註記是危險提示，不是可操作深度資料。來源未列孕婦、兒童或抗凝用藥者的專屬規則，本卡不猜。
cautionsEn: The curriculum explicitly directs the practitioner to avoid the temporal vein and insert gently.

eLotus and AD list prick-to-bleed, and AD specifies a few drops for acute conjunctivitis or headache. The three content sources give no hemostasis protocol, so the legacy 'attend to hemostasis' warning is retained without invented steps.

AD's 0.5-1.5/1-2-cun through-needling toward GB8 and 3-cun through-needling toward ST6 differ substantially from the shared 0.3-0.5-cun baseline. They are limited to licensed acupuncturists formally trained in temporal anatomy and those techniques.
AD's martial-arts fatal-point note is a danger signal, not usable depth guidance.
The sources reviewed give no point-specific pregnancy, pediatric, or anticoagulation rules; none are guessed.
evidence: 四來源整合：NCBAHM Appendix A 確認範圍；課件 p.9 提供 M-HN-9、定位、袪風清熱消腫止痛、0.5~1與1~2寸技法及避血管警語；eLotus 提供 EX-HN5、0.3~0.5寸／點刺放血共同基線、清頭明目與核心主治；AD 補多種來源別透刺、完整功效主治、配穴及常用局部穴註記。既有醒腦與止血警語不刪除，但分別標示未直接列為功效／未提供程序。

location: 眶下緣，外側1/4與內側3/4交界處。
locationEn: On the inferior orbital margin, at the junction of the lateral one-quarter and medial three-quarters.
cunMeasurement: 不以寸量為主；將眶下緣由外向內分為四等分，取外1/4與內3/4的交界。
anatomyZh: 位於眼球與眶下壁／眶下緣相關的眶內進針區。AD 明確描述針行於眼球與眶下壁之間，並警告過深可能進入顱腔；四來源未提供更完整的逐層神經血管圖譜。本穴屬高風險眼眶操作，不能由一般表面定位推定安全。
anatomyEn: This is an intra-orbital needling region related to the globe and inferior orbital wall/margin. AD explicitly describes passage between the eyeball and inferior orbital wall and warns that excessive depth may enter the cranial cavity; the four sources provide no fuller layer-by-layer neurovascular map. This is a high-risk orbital technique and safety cannot be inferred from surface location alone.
techniqueNotes:
eLotus：輕推眼球向上，沿眶緣緩慢直刺0.5~1.2寸；禁止提插、捻轉。AD：一法令患者閉眼向上看，在眼球與眶下壁之間先略向下再直刺0.5~1寸；另一法固定眼球後略向內上方、朝視神經方向緩慢直刺1~1.5寸，並警告不可過深以免進入顱腔。AD 要求慢進針、不得提插捻轉，出針後立即以棉球在針孔處牢固按壓約1分鐘防血腫，且僅限有適當臨床經驗者。舊卡『出針壓迫眼球』改正為按壓針孔，不壓眼球。
eLotus: gently displace the eyeball upward and slowly insert perpendicularly 0.5-1.2 cun along the orbital margin; lifting, thrusting, twisting, and rotating are contraindicated. AD: one method has the patient close the eyes and look upward, inserting first slightly inferiorly then perpendicularly 0.5-1 cun between the globe and inferior orbital wall; another stabilizes the globe and slowly inserts slightly medially and upward toward the optic nerve 1-1.5 cun, warning against excessive depth because of possible cranial entry. AD requires slow insertion without manipulation, immediate firm cotton-ball pressure over the needle site for about one minute after withdrawal to prevent hematoma, and appropriate clinical experience. The legacy instruction to 'press the eyeball' after withdrawal is corrected to pressure over the needle site, not the globe.
acumethodZh: eLotus：眼球輕推向上，沿眶緣緩慢直刺0.5~1.2寸，禁提插捻轉。AD：閉眼向上看，在眼球與眶下壁之間0.5~1寸；另列固定眼球、略向內上方朝視神經方向1~1.5寸。AD 明警不可過深、不得操作手法，僅限有適當臨床經驗者。
acumethodEn: eLotus: gently move the globe upward and slowly insert 0.5-1.2 cun along the orbital margin, with no lifting, thrusting, twisting, or rotating. AD: with eyes closed and looking upward, insert 0.5-1 cun between the globe and inferior orbital wall; it also lists a 1-1.5-cun slightly medial/upward direction toward the optic nerve after stabilizing the globe. AD warns against excessive depth and manipulation and limits the method to practitioners with appropriate clinical experience.

Because the defined target is itself the left sublingual vein, the legacy phrase 'avoid major vessels' is not operationally precise. The card instead says to act only on the confirmed target and avoid the central frenulum and non-target sublingual structures.

Legacy cautions on no deep insertion, bleeding control, bleeding disorders/anticoagulants/oral infection/inability to cooperate, and no needle retention are retained as Me & Qi/anatomical procedural notes, not four-source consensus.

cautions: eLotus 與 AD 只寫點刺出血，未給針具、深度、滴數、重複次數、消毒或止血流程，且未列本穴禁忌。定位本身即為舌下右側靜脈，因此舊卡『避開大血管』不能當成可操作的精確指令；本輪改為『只處理已確認的目標點，避免中央繫帶與非目標舌下結構』。既有禁深刺、禁灸、控制出血、凝血異常／抗凝藥／口腔感染／無法配合者慎用、一般不留針等警語保留；其中禁灸未獲 eLotus／AD 支持，其他為 Me & Qi／解剖程序提示，不冒充四來源共識。AD 列晨吐與妊娠嘔吐是主治，不等於妊娠安全許可；四來源未提供孕婦或兒童專屬操作規則，不猜。
cautionsEn: eLotus and AD only state bloodletting; they give no instrument, depth, drop count, repetition, antisepsis, or hemostasis protocol and list no point-specific contraindication.

Because the defined target is itself the right sublingual vein, the legacy phrase 'avoid major vessels' is not operationally precise. The card instead says to act only on the confirmed target and avoid the central frenulum and non-target sublingual structures.

Legacy cautions on no deep insertion, no moxa, bleeding control, bleeding disorders/anticoagulants/oral infection/inability to cooperate, and no retention are preserved. The no-moxa statement is not supported by eLotus/AD; the others remain Me & Qi/anatomical procedural notes, not four-source consensus.
AD's morning-sickness and pregnancy-vomiting indications are not pregnancy safety clearance. The four sources provide no point-specific pregnancy or pediatric procedure rule; none is guessed.
exam_importance: NCBAHM Appendix A 與現有課件未列玉液，不標 Board 核心。辨位與編碼重點：金津左、玉液右、海泉中央；eLotus 分列 EX-HN12／13，AD 合併為 M-HN-20。

exam_pearl_en: Jinjin is left, Yuye right, and Haiquan midline; Jinjin-Yuye are commonly treated as a bloodletting pair. Yuye's legacy no-moxa warning is not confirmed by eLotus/AD, and AD's pregnancy-vomiting indication is not pregnancy safety approval.

【中風失語】金津玉液配聚泉（EX-HN10）、廉泉（CV23）、內關（PC6）：利舌開音、醒神通絡。

combinePointsEn:
Swollen tongue / throat obstruction: Yuye with Jinjin (EX-HN12) and Haiquan (EX-HN11), often by sublingual bloodletting, clears Heat and reduces swelling.
Post-stroke aphasia: Jinjin-Yuye with Juquan (EX-HN10), Lianquan (CV23), and Neiguan (PC6) benefits the tongue, opens speech, and unblocks collaterals.
Wasting-thirst with dry mouth: Jinjin-Yuye with Chengjiang (CV24), Quchi (LI11), and Taichong (LR3) clears Heat and generates fluids.
clinical_pearls: eLotus 將玉液主治收斂為失語／舌強痛腫與嘔吐；AD 擴充口瘡、喉痹、消渴、失音、胃炎、妊娠嘔吐與劇烈噁心。AD 第二條定位句疑有 Jinjin／Yuye 文字誤植；本卡以其第一條與 eLotus 左右雙頁校正。Me & Qi 安全內容保留但標為四來源契約外。

locationEn: On anterior lateral lower leg, approx 2 cun below Zusanli (ST 36).
techniqueNotes:
